title: Thailand plans crypto ETF rules as institutional interest increases
summary: Thailand’s SEC is planning new crypto ETF and futures trading regulations as the country looks to position itself as a regional crypto hub for institutions.

title: Saga pauses chainlet after $7M exploit that depegged its stablecoin
summary: Saga’s US dollar-pegged stablecoin has dropped to $0.75, while the protocol's total value locked has fallen by around 55% over the past 24 hours.

title: Don’t bet on institutional investors to run Bitcoin to $150K: Researcher
summary: FFTT founder Luke Gromen said institutional investors may not do much for Bitcoin's price this year, but other analysts have previously argued they’ll be key to a Bitcoin resurgence.

title: Buterin tips distributed validators to simplify Ethereum staking
summary: While complex to set up, distributed validator technology could improve Ethereum’s staking experience, according to the creator of Ethereum.

title: Columbia professor says NYSE tokenization plan reads like ‘vaporware’
summary: NYSE unveiled a plan on Monday to enable blockchain-based 24/7 trading and instant settlement of stocks and ETFs, in addition to custody features.

title: No deal yet with Dems on crypto bill, Senator Boozman confirms
summary: The US Senate Agriculture Committee released a Republican draft of the market structure bill, which includes protections for crypto developers, setting it up for a markup next week.

title: Bitwise says Q4 showed signs of a bear market bottom
summary: Bitwise’s Matt Hougan argued crypto markets performed poorly in Q4 despite strong fundamentals, similar to early 2023 when crypto rebounded from 2022 lows.

title: Crypto could hit $28T by 2030 on Bitcoin, DeFi, tokenization: ARK
summary: ARK Invest’s latest analysis affirms it still sees Bitcoin reaching close to a $1 million price tag in 2030 on growing adoption.

title: X to roll out ‘Starterpacks’ featuring Bitcoin and crypto’s top posters
summary: X head of product Nikita Bier said the feature will launch in a few weeks, and already has over 1,000 pre-made “packs” of accounts to follow in each interest category — such as memecoin trading and crypto.

title: US stocks, crypto creep up as Trump calls off Greenland-linked tariffs
summary: The S&P 500 climbed, crypto stocks were mixed and Bitcoin and Ether posted modest gains on Wednesday after Donald Trump called off his recent tariff threat.
